create_render_layer: create a RenderLayer module with height, width, face indices, texture coordinates, and texture face indices
render_mesh_with_drtk: render a textured 3D mesh using the RenderLayer forward pass with vertices, texture, camera matrix, and pose
rasterize_vertices_to_image: rasterize transformed vertex positions into an index image using drtk rasterize with face indices and image dimensions
apply_edge_gradient_estimator: apply the edge gradient estimator to a rendered image using vertex positions, face indices, and barycentric coordinates
interpolate_texture_coordinates: interpolate texture coordinates across a rasterized mesh using drtk interpolate with barycentric weights and face indices
